The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly
broken, and the trunk lid shows a crease consistent with the reported rear impact. The
damage pattern liens up with the described collision, and nothing I found points to

lamp, refinishing the trunk lid, and checking the rear panel for hidden deformation.
